"""Independent read-only owner-event audit and saved-SMT replay; no Cargo/native."""
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT = Path('/Users/erik/.codex/worktrees/1598/umf')
OWNER = Path('/Users/erik/Projects/weft')
SELF = Path('/private/tmp/rule-occurrences-astra-review.py')
if Path.cwd().resolve() != ROOT or Path(__file__).resolve() != SELF or len(sys.argv) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Unknown exact review invocation')
BASE = ROOT / 'docs/helix/04-build/evidence/security'
OUT = BASE / 'rule-occurrences-astra-review.json'
LOG = Path('/private/tmp/security-rule-occurrences-core.log')
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
groups = [
    ('rule-occurrence-addresses-formal', [
        'ordered-child-addresses-cannot-collapse',
        'condition-operand-disclosure-namespaces-stay-distinct',
        'repeated-owner-occurrences-retain-source-coordinate',
    ], [ROOT / 'tools/security/prove-rule-occurrence-addresses.py',
        ROOT / 'docs/helix/02-design/spikes/security/backend-requirement-issuer-v0.2.md',
        OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_rule_occurrences.rs']),
    ('source-demands-formal', [
        'whole-capability-before-source-quantifier',
        'different-scopes-may-use-different-complete-capabilities',
        'original-use-needs-primary-original-and-application',
        'equal-marginals-cannot-substitute-scoped-edges',
        'source-correspondence-cannot-discharge-native-execution',
    ], [ROOT / 'tools/security/prove-source-demands.py',
        ROOT / 'docs/helix/02-design/spikes/security/source-demand-binding-v0.1.md',
        OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_obligation_sources.rs',
        OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_semantic_coverage.rs']),
    ('kind-completeness-formal', [
        'same-source-kinds-cannot-fragment-across-origins',
        'different-scopes-may-use-different-instance-complete-origins',
        'instance-completeness-cannot-discharge-native-evidence',
    ], [ROOT / 'tools/security/prove-kind-completeness.py',
        ROOT / 'docs/helix/02-design/spikes/security/backend-requirement-issuer-v0.2.md',
        OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_obligation_matching.rs']),
]
spec = importlib.util.find_spec('z3')
assert spec and spec.origin
solver_root = Path(spec.origin).resolve().parent
def solver_files():
    return {p for p in solver_root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts and p.suffix != '.pyc'}
runtime_paths = solver_files()
paths = {SELF, LOG, BASE / 'rule-occurrences.json', OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/lib.rs', OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_ir.rs', OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_requirements.rs', Path(sys.executable).resolve(), *runtime_paths,
         OWNER / 'docs/helix/02-design/contracts/CONTRACT-005-security-compilation.md'}
for name, laws, source_paths in groups:
    paths.add(BASE / (name + '.json'))
    paths.update(source_paths)
frozen = {str(p): p.read_bytes() for p in sorted(paths)}
prior = OUT.read_bytes() if OUT.exists() else None
historical_paths = [BASE / 'rule-event-astra-review.json', BASE / 'owner-events-astra-review.json', BASE / 'kind-instance-astra-review.json',
                    BASE / 'kind-completeness-astra-review.json',
                    BASE / 'scoped-obligations-astra-review.json']
historical = {str(p): p.read_bytes() for p in historical_paths if p.exists()}
import z3
assert z3.get_version_string() == '4.15.4'
formal_observations, receipt_audits = [], []
for name, laws, source_paths in groups:
    path = BASE / (name + '.json')
    raw = frozen[str(path)]
    proof = json.loads(raw)
    expected_pins = {str(p): sha(frozen[str(p)]) for p in source_paths}
    assert proof['sourceDigests'] == expected_pins, name + ': source inventory/digest mismatch'
    assert proof['status'] == ('conditional-algebraic-address-laws-passed' if name == 'rule-occurrence-addresses-formal' else 'conditional-proof-passed') and proof['sourcesUnchanged'] is True
    assert proof['nativeImplementationQualified'] is False and proof['acceptanceCasesPromoted'] == []
    assert proof['solverVersion'] == '4.15.4'
    assert [c['id'] for c in proof['cases']] == laws
    for case in proof['cases']:
        assert case['covers'] == ['US-056-AC7', 'US-056-AC10']
        for kind, expected in [('violation', 'unsat'), ('negativeControl', 'sat'), ('positivePopulation', 'sat')]:
            query = case[kind]
            assert query['result'] == expected and query['replayResult'] == expected
            ctx = z3.Context()
            solver = z3.Solver(ctx=ctx)
            solver.set(timeout=30000)
            solver.from_string(query['smt'])
            observed = str(solver.check())
            if observed != expected:
                raise RuntimeError(name + '/' + case['id'] + '/' + kind + ': ' + observed)
            formal_observations.append({'id': name + '/' + case['id'] + '/' + kind,
                'receipt': name, 'law': case['id'], 'queryKind': kind,
                'expected': expected, 'observed': observed,
                'smtSha256': sha(query['smt'].encode()), 'freshContext': True})
            del solver, ctx
    receipt_audits.append({'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(raw),
        'lawCount': len(laws), 'formulaCount': len(laws) * 3,
        'sourceDigests': expected_pins, 'exactSourceInventoryMatched': True})
assert len(formal_observations) == 33 and len({o['id'] for o in formal_observations}) == 33
assert sum(o['observed'] == 'unsat' for o in formal_observations) == 11
assert sum(o['observed'] == 'sat' for o in formal_observations) == 22

# Independently account for source "s", no disclosures, Not(Equal(left,right)).
charges = [('five retained-entry source charges', 5, 5),
           ('root empty path copy', 1, 0), ('one child stack position', 1, 8),
           ('three one-index path copies', 3, 24)]
assert (sum(c[1] for c in charges), sum(c[2] for c in charges)) == (10, 37)
log = frozen[str(LOG)].decode()
summaries = re.findall(r'^test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out; finished in [0-9.]+s$', log, re.M)
assert summaries == [('131', '0', '0', '0', '0')]
test_names = [
    'security_rule_occurrences::tests::independent_small_ledger_accounts_for_stack_and_each_owned_path',
    'security_rule_occurrences::tests::exact_paths_keep_false_empty_nodes_operands_and_repeated_disclosures',
    'security_rule_occurrences::tests::exact_occurrence_and_depth_boundaries_refuse_without_returning_inventory',
    'security_semantic_coverage::tests::issued_source_demands_match_independent_complete_fixture_map_and_exact_budgets',
    'security_semantic_coverage::tests::rule_event_custody_retains_both_scan_and_action_coordinates',
    'security_semantic_coverage::tests::issued_source_demands_keep_output_selfjoin_and_false_branch_ownership',
]
for name in test_names:
    assert len(re.findall(r'^test ' + re.escape(name) + r' \.\.\. ok$', log, re.M)) == 1
parent_path = BASE / 'rule-occurrences.json'
parent = json.loads(frozen[str(parent_path)])
assert parent['status'] == 'private-rule-occurrence-custody-tests-passed'
assert parent['summary'] == {'passed':131, 'failed':0}
assert type(parent['exitCode']) is int and parent['exitCode'] == 0
assert parent['rawOutputSha256'] == sha(frozen[str(LOG)])
assert parent['selectedPostRunSourcePins'] == {str(p):sha(frozen[str(p)]) for p in [
    OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_rule_occurrences.rs',
    OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_obligation_sources.rs',
    OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/security_semantic_coverage.rs',
    OWNER / 'crates/weft-core/src/lib.rs']}
assert parent['freshNativeExecution'] is False and parent['promotedAcceptanceCases'] == []
observations = [
    {'id':'borrowed-owner-custody-and-complete-structural-match', 'expected':True,'observed':True,
     'method':'Read-only source review: entries borrow actual Rule/Expression/Term/disclosure references and retain the exact private OwnerSourceDemands. Exhaustive Expression matching visits false/empty branches without evaluation.'},
    {'id':'independent-not-equal-ledger', 'expected':{'work':10,'bytesAt64Bit':37},
     'observed':{'work':sum(c[1] for c in charges),'bytesAt64Bit':sum(c[2] for c in charges)},
     'chargesAt64Bit':[{'operation':n,'work':w,'bytes':b} for n,w,b in charges],
     'portableByteFormula':'5 + 4 * sizeof(usize)',
     'method':'Independent source accounting. Parent test checks exact ledger exhaustion and both minus-one refusals; no independent Rust execution.'},
    {'id':'exact-operand-pointers-at-four-authored-equality-paths', 'expected':[[0,0],[0,1,0,0],[0,1,0,1],[0,1,0,2]],
     'observed':[[0,0],[0,1,0,0],[0,1,0,1],[0,1,0,2]],
     'method':'Read-only test review: each actual Equal has distinct left/right addresses and both issued operands must equal the respective original Term pointer.'},
    {'id':'nested-exists-payload-custody', 'expected':{'outerSlot':0,'outerAssociation':'Ownership','innerSlot':1,'innerAssociation':'Assignment'},
     'observed':{'outerSlot':0,'outerAssociation':'Ownership','innerSlot':1,'innerAssociation':'Assignment'},
     'method':'Read-only test review: actual nested Exists structure/slots/association IDs and original condition/node pointers are checked.'},
    {'id':'registered-occurrence-inventory-counts', 'expected':{'golden':20,'twoScansTwoActions':80,'twoScansFalseBranch':44},
     'observed':{'golden':20,'twoScansTwoActions':80,'twoScansFalseBranch':44},
     'method':'Parent actual registered fixture checks; golden20 keys independently authored, repeated-scope80 and false-branch44 counts checked in source/pass lines. Parent-attributed only.'},
    {'id':'primitive-entry-and-path-boundaries', 'expected':{'maxEntries':4096,'overEntries':4097,'maxPathEdges':64,'overPathEdges':65,'rootPathLength':0},
     'observed':{'maxEntries':4096,'overEntries':4097,'maxPathEdges':64,'overPathEdges':65,'rootPathLength':0},
     'method':'Read-only source and primitive-test review; 64 child edges allows65 expression levels. Operands, child and disclosure positions zero-based. No aggregate CPU/memory bound or actual admitted-source depth64 claim.'},
    {'id':'disclosure-order-and-empty-node-custody', 'expected':True,'observed':True,
     'method':'Parent primitive independently names paths and repeated disclosure positions; each field/disposition pointer checked including Original/Withheld/Transformed. Empty node is retained.'},
    {'id':'algebraic-law-scope', 'expected':True,'observed':True,
     'method':'Reviewed constructor injectivity/disjointness/source-coordinate models and explicit erased-coordinate controls. Address identity does not prove Vec encoding, traversal completeness, source extraction, bounds, applicability or native enforcement.'},
]
assert solver_files() == runtime_paths
if any(Path(p).read_bytes() != data for p, data in frozen.items()):
    raise RuntimeError('Captured input/runtime changed')
if any(Path(p).read_bytes() != data for p, data in historical.items()):
    raise RuntimeError('Historical review changed')
if (OUT.read_bytes() if OUT.exists() else None) != prior:
    raise RuntimeError('Previous owner-event review changed')
receipt = {
    'id': 'rule-occurrences-astra-review', 'status': 'qualified-rule-occurrence-review-passed',
    'reviewer': '/root/astra_security_review', 'generatedAt': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'sourceDigests': {p: sha(data) for p, data in frozen.items()}, 'sourcesUnchanged': True,
    'reviewCommand': {'argv': [sys.executable, str(SELF)], 'cwd': str(ROOT),
        'sourceSha256': sha(frozen[str(SELF)]), 'source': frozen[str(SELF)].decode()},
    'formalReplay': {'solverVersion': z3.get_version_string(), 'formulaCount': 33,
        'unsatCount': 11, 'satCount': 22, 'receipts': receipt_audits, 'observations': formal_observations},
    'observations': observations,
    'parentRustExecution': {'attribution': 'Parent-produced log; inspected only, not independently executed by this review.',
        'path': str(LOG), 'sha256': sha(frozen[str(LOG)]), 'log': log,
        'summary': {'passed': 131, 'failed': 0, 'ignored': 0, 'measured': 0, 'filtered': 0},
        'requiredPassLines': test_names, 'independentlyExecuted': False, 'parentReceiptPath': str(parent_path), 'parentReceiptSha256': sha(frozen[str(parent_path)]),
        'buildSourceCustodyQualifiedByThisReview': False},
    'historicalReviews': [{'path': p, 'sha256': sha(data), 'preservedUnchanged': True,
        'scope': 'Historical only; no pin refresh or freshness assertion.'} for p, data in historical.items()],
    'scope': 'Read-only review of current private typed rule-occurrence custody and its final pointer/path/budget controls. Independently replayed9 algebraic occurrence-address,15 finite source-demand and9 finite kind-completeness saved SMT formulas in separate fresh contexts, with exact closed law IDs, expected outcomes and current proof source path/digest inventories. The three constructor identity laws concern arbitrary finite algebraic paths, not Rust Vec or traversal refinement; the remaining eight laws are finite conditional Boolean models. No formula proves owner extraction, independently complete semantic kind/occurrence or case inventories, authenticated profiles, native enforcement or release. The 131-test log and four selected post-run parent pins are parent-attributed only; no complete Rust build-custody claim. No Cargo, producer or native fixture was run. Selected review/runtime pins do not form a complete Rust build closure. Python executable and selected complete Z3 package files are pinned; platform/dynamic system libraries remain trusted. No backend acceptance case is promoted.',
    'remainingFindings': [], 'nativeImplementationQualified': False, 'acceptanceCasesPromoted': [],
    'acceptanceCriteria': ['US-056-AC7', 'US-056-AC10'],
}
if prior is not None:
    h = sha(prior)
    archive = OUT.with_name(OUT.stem + '-prior-' + h[:16] + '.json')
    if archive.exists() and archive.read_bytes() != prior:
        raise RuntimeError('Archive collision')
    if not archive.exists(): archive.write_bytes(prior)
    receipt['previousReceipt'] = {'path': str(archive), 'sha256': h, 'scope': 'Historical only.'}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'status': receipt['status'], 'formulaCount': 33, 'unsat': 11, 'sat': 22,
    'sourcePins': len(frozen), 'sourcesUnchanged': True, 'remainingFindings': [],
    'parentRustTests': 131, 'independentRustExecution': False,
    'output': str(OUT), 'sha256': sha(OUT.read_bytes())}))
